evidence.quote: substantive laws of Sweden

trains_on_content.note: Terms section 5.2 lets Mentimeter analyse User Data to improve the Services. Section 5.1 gives it an anonymized licence to Free-user Mentis for product development. Section 5.5 bars third parties from training on content.

evidence.quote: OpenAI may retain this data for up to 30 days for abuse-monitoring and operational security purposes
workspace-level controls to disable AI features are available on relevant plans

ai_act_statement.note: AI FAQ says Mentimeter 'continuously monitors developments in relevant regulations, including the EU AI Act, and will adapt our practices as required.' This is monitoring language, not a transparency or position statement. Checked the AI page, trust pages and legal pages on 2026-11-16.

evidence.quote: Mentimeter's information security management system is certified under ISO 27001:2022

certifications.note: Vendor claim on the AI FAQ and an ISO27001 badge on the trust page. No certificate was checked.

evidence.quote: Focus on creating interactive presentations while we keep your data safe.
All data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

encryption.note: Security policy: TLS 1.2 or higher in transit, AES-256 at rest. No customer-managed keys stated.

evidence.quote: Yes, we perform annual penetration testing on our web applications through a third-party vendor.

pentest.note: No public summary of test results found.

incidents.note: Two searches (general breach, and IMY/Datatilsynet regulator decisions, 2026-11-16). No vendor notice, regulator decision or court record naming Mentimeter found. Third-party breach trackers were not used as evidence.

status_page.note: No status link on the homepage or legal pages. status.mentimeter.com does not resolve.

evidence.quote: SCIM Automate license and role management
